name: Michael Han
bio: Michael Han is a co-founder of Unsloth, a company that makes fine-tuning and local running of open models easier. They are credited alongside Daniel Han as an author of the Unsloth project. Their Hugging Face profile shows long-running activity in community discussions and membership in the Unsloth, Qwen, and IBM Granite organizations.
known_for: Co-author credit on the Unsloth project
Community support for fine-tuning open models
